title: MultisensoryFlickerHealthyYoungAdults_AllSubjectsRawData
description: This dataset contains scalp EEG recordings from healthy young adults exposed to one hour of 40 Hz audiovisual flicker stimulation, no-flicker control, or randomized sham flicker, while performing a psychomotor vigilance task. The dataset aims to investigate the neural effects of multisensory gamma-frequency flicker stimulation in humans.
methods_description: Scalp EEG activity was recorded from healthy adults during one hour of either 40 Hz audiovisual flicker, no flicker (control), or randomized flicker (sham) stimulation, while subjects performed a psychomotor vigilance task.
